title: Story premise ENT039: The Record-Groove Express
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (miniature adventure). Hook: The road goes around. The address is in the middle. Takeaway/theme: A route can follow the landscape instead of fighting it.
description: A toy traveler must reach a label at the center of a slowly turning oversized record, but walking straight keeps carrying them sideways. They ride a fictional groove-following sled inward, step onto the stationary display spindle platform, and discover the parcel was a tiny dance invitation.
